issues.description: Method calculateRemainingOrderNumber(): the problem statement (UML and textual specification) requires a method calculateRemainingOrderNumber() that returns an int (the number of remaining orders). The solution implementation declares public void calculateRemainingOrderNumber() (SealSaloon.java) and only prints order numbers instead of returning an int. This mismatch between the specified return type (int) and the implemented return type (void) will confuse students and break any tests or code that expect an int result.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the method signature in SealSaloon to public int calculateRemainingOrderNumber() and have it return the number of remaining orders (e.g., return this.orders.length). If printing order numbers for demonstration is desired, keep the printing but also return the integer count so the method matches the problem statement and UML. Update any callers/tests that expect the returned value accordingly.
